focus_checks.name: native map tiles render with attribution and bounded visible images; pan and zoom preserve data
trusted map pinch, pointer cancellation and route cleanup stay within the map
native Maps saves coordinates, home shortcuts and directions preferences
native Maps coordinate search and recent history need no network lookup
six native live-card templates, capped badge and finite flip render
queued cards rotate and scheduled expiry survives reduced motion without saving
native tile customization, folder creation and dissolution preserve full records
native live-folder cover, expansion and child activation retain tile identity

visual_review.finding: Fixture tiles fill the measured viewport; coordinates, zoom controls, scale and OSM attribution remain visible. No overlap with app bar or system navigation.
Remounted viewport is filled, its changed zoom is visible, and attribution/navigation remain intact.
Pinned-place activation renders the saved title/address/coordinates and centered marker in the detail map with its native app bar.
All six templates render: text, flip front, list, progress, photo and photo cycle. Count cap, separate badge, progress track and local images are visible without overflow.
Custom color and hidden label/badge apply to one tile while the adjacent tile retains its label and badge.
Folder preserves two child tile previews, their independent backgrounds and content, and the custom folder title.
Expanded folder renders both full child tiles beneath the live cover, with retained glyphs/badges and a visible close control.
